definitions.explanation: A person who writes books, articles, or other written works.
A person who creates artistic works such as manga, plays, or other creative works.

notes:
{作者|さくしゃ} refers to the creator or author of a creative work such as books, manga, plays, or art.

WORD FORMATION:
{作|さく} (create) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→者：04662_sha⟧ (person) = creator/author

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作者|さくしゃ}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: author unknown
- ⟦{原作者|げんさくしゃ}→原作者：22123_gensakusha⟧: original author
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作者|さくしゃ}: the author of this work

COMPARE SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作者|さくしゃ}: creator/author (of specific works)
- ⟦{著者|ちょしゃ}→著者：03501_chosha⟧: author (formal, often non-fiction)
- ⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: writer/author (as profession)
- ⟦{筆者|ひっしゃ}→筆者：04348_hissha⟧: writer (of current text, "this writer")

USAGE:
{作者|さくしゃ} is commonly used for ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧ artists, novelists, and playwrights when referring to their specific works.
